title: Strange New Worlds Season 4: Gimmicks Over Character
excerpt: A professional analysis of how Strange New Worlds Season 4 sacrifices character arcs for high-concept gimmicks, drawing direct parallels to software development pitfalls like feature creep and technical debt.
description: A critical review of Strange New Worlds Season 4, showing how gimmick episodes stunt character growth, mirroring software feature creep and tech debt.
